description: Na₃N₂H₄S₃O₉NH₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. The structure consists of four NH₂ clusters inside a Na₃N₂H₄S₃O₉ framework. In each NH₂ cluster, N is bonded in a water-like geometry to two equivalent H atoms. There is one shorter (1.03 Å) and one longer (1.04 Å) N-H bond length. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the Na₃N₂H₄S₃O₉ framework, there are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four SNO₃ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.69 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.67 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two H and one S atom. Both N-H bond lengths are 1.03 Å. The N-S bond length is 1.66 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two H and one S atom. Both N-H bond lengths are 1.03 Å. The N-S bond length is 1.68 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form SNO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-46°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.49 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.48 Å) and one longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond length. In the third S site, S is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form SNO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-60°. There are two shorter (1.47 Å) and one longer (1.48 Å) S-O bond length. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom.
